title.zh: 经络医学体系总览：察经—辨经—选经—选穴—手法，并回到经典经络理论
title.en: The Channel-Medicine System at a Glance: Examine, Differentiate, Choose Channels, Choose Points, Technique, and a Return to Classical Channel Theory

summary.zh: 王居易把针灸治疗建成一条以经络为核心贯穿始终的链：经络穴结构、经络气化、经络诊察、症候结构、辨经选经、选穴应用、手法探源。关键是临床思维方法；他主张针灸理论必须“认祖归宗”，回到《内经》经络理论，而不是靠移植现代理论或堆“经验穴”。
summary.en: Wang Juyi builds acupuncture treatment as one chain run through by the channels: channel/point structure, channel qi-transformation, channel examination, symptom-complex structure, channel differentiation and selection, point application, and the source of technique. The key is clinical thinking; he holds that acupuncture theory must return to the classical channel theory of the Neijing, not to transplanted modern theory or piles of "experience points".

takeaways.zh: 经络与穴的结构是核心：他认为经络存在于各组织器官的缝隙中，内含气血等精微物质，形成压力、势位，在皮、脉、肉、筋、骨间成渗透的网状结构；穴依附经络，也在皮脉肉筋骨的缝隙里，缝隙宽窄、深浅、大小不同，所以《内经》用井荥输经合、溪沟池海来形容和命名穴。
takeaways.en: Structure comes first: channels lie in the gaps between tissues and organs and carry qi, blood and other fine substances, forming pressure and potential and a permeable network among skin, vessel, flesh, sinew and bone; points depend on channels and sit in the same gaps, and because the gaps differ in width, depth and size the Neijing describes points by jing-ying-shu-jing-he and names them stream, ditch, pool, sea.

takeaways.zh: 整个体系是一条链，而不是一堆穴方：理论上含经络穴结构、经络气化、经络诊察、症候结构、辨经选经、选穴应用、手法探源七块；治疗上是察经→辨经→选经→选穴→针灸操作一体，以经络贯穿始终，关键在临床思维方法。他说这套辨经论治思想也适用于任何有调整经络作用的治疗方法；而诊察经络是选穴施术前必须做的步骤。
takeaways.en: The whole is a chain, not a heap of point formulas: seven theoretical blocks (channel/point structure, qi-transformation, examination, symptom-complex structure, differentiation and selection of channels, point application, source of technique) and one therapeutic sequence, examine → differentiate → choose channel → choose points → needle/moxa operation, with the channels running through it all and clinical thinking as the key. He adds that this channel-based reasoning fits any treatment that adjusts the channels, and that examining the channels is a step that must precede point selection and needling.

takeaways.zh: “症候结构”是他自己的概念，不等于中医的“证”：把患者与医者能感觉到的各种症状分析整合，找出内在联系和影响因素，成为相对稳定的结构；它是诊病的关键环节，直接关系到下一步准确辨经、选经。
takeaways.en: "Symptom-complex structure" is his own concept and is not the same as TCM zheng: the symptoms felt by patient or noticed by physician are analysed and integrated to find their internal links and influencing factors, forming a relatively stable structure; it is the key link in diagnosis and bears directly on accurate channel differentiation and selection.

takeaways.zh: 察经发现的异常经脉不一定就是当下病症的经络：经络有记忆功能，旧病症状消失后仍可留下印记；经络也灵敏，气血失衡时症状未现经络已先有反应。所以察经之后必须把异常经络与临床症候对接，按经络气化和病候理论辨别标本传变、虚实缓急，才进入选经。
takeaways.en: An abnormal channel found on examination need not be the channel of the present complaint: channels remember past illness, leaving a trace after symptoms vanish, and they react sensitively, showing changes before symptoms appear. So after examination the abnormal channels must be matched with the clinical symptoms and differentiated by qi-transformation and channel-disease theory (root/branch, deficiency/excess, urgency) before channels are chosen.

takeaways.zh: 穴位置会变，所以“循摸”是他强调的重中之重：每个穴虽有标准定位，但骨骼肌肉发育和生理病理状态不同，穴位会变动；针每一个穴之前都必须仔细循摸，才能定位到真正的穴。选穴精少，但要求准确，并对得气要求很高。
takeaways.en: Points move, so palpating for the point is his top priority: each has a standard location, but skeletal and muscular development and physiological or pathological state shift it; before needling every point one must palpate carefully to find the true one. He selects few points, but they must be exact and he demands strong de-qi.

takeaways.zh: 手法也要“探源”：他把《史记》里俞跗“割皮解肌，决脉结筋”的描述看作古代手法的记载，在临床中整理出割皮法、操法、结筋法、解肌法、决脉法；他的责任观是把这一理论方法“破解、验证、应用”。
takeaways.en: Technique is also traced to its source: he reads the Shiji account of Yu Fu, "cut skin, loosen muscle, open vessels, bind sinews", as a record of ancient manual methods and has worked out from it the skin-cutting, manipulation (cao), sinew-binding, muscle-loosening and vessel-opening methods, holding it our duty to decode, test and apply them.

takeaways.zh: 针灸理论要“认祖归宗”：自序说，一百多年来许多学者移植现代西医与科学理论来替代经络医学，他自己也研究过经络电阻、闸门学说、所谓奇穴新穴等，最后仍是从经典经络理论里读到针灸的内核；古今医案又太简要，只记“什么症用哪些穴”，只留下大量“经验穴”“特效穴”。
takeaways.en: Theory must "return to the ancestors": the preface says that for a century many scholars transplanted modern medicine and science to replace channel theory; he studied meridian resistance, gate theory, so-called new and extra points himself, yet found the core of acupuncture in the classical channel theory; and old case records are too brief, listing "which points for which illness", leaving mostly "experience points" and "special-effect points".

takeaways.zh: 他不盲从权威，不追求“秘方”“绝招”：头痛医案的按语说，头痛不可能用单一方药或一组穴“全包”，这样的说法违反中医理论，选经选穴只能随经络诊察与症候结构而变。
takeaways.en: He follows no authority blindly and chases no "secret formula" or "trick": in the headache commentary he says headache cannot be covered by one prescription or one point group, and that claims of such "special points" contradict TCM theory; channels and points must follow examination and symptom-complex structure.

title.zh: 体系七块：他在书中各自怎么说
title.en: The seven blocks of the system and what the book says of each

rows.zh: 经络穴结构
rows.en: Channel/point structure

rows.zh: 经络存在于组织缝隙，含气血，形成压力势位；穴在皮脉肉筋骨的缝隙中，缝隙宽窄深浅不同
rows.en: Channels lie in tissue gaps, hold qi and blood, form pressure and potential; points lie in gaps of skin/vessel/flesh/sinew/bone that differ in width and depth

rows.zh: 经络气化
rows.en: Channel qi-transformation

rows.zh: 如三阴三阳的“开”“阖”“枢”：手足太阴在三阴主“开”，即宣发；厥阴主阖；书中用它解释为何取某经
rows.en: e.g. the "open/close/pivot" of the three yin and three yang: the two taiyin channels "open" (disperse), jueyin "closes"; the book uses this to explain why a channel is chosen

rows.zh: 经络诊察
rows.en: Channel examination

rows.zh: 审、切、循、扪、按；规范了望诊范围、切诊路线、体位与手法，总结各经各穴常见异常
rows.en: Inspect, press, trace, palpate, push; standardised the inspection field, palpation routes, patient posture and hand method, and the usual abnormalities of each channel and point

rows.zh: 症候结构
rows.en: Symptom-complex structure

rows.zh: 主症＋相关症候＋舌脉，分析整合成相对稳定的结构；有别于“证”
rows.en: Chief complaint + linked symptoms + tongue and pulse, analysed into a fairly stable structure; distinct from zheng

rows.zh: 辨经选经
rows.en: Differentiate and choose channels

rows.zh: 把症候结构与异常经脉对接；选经用本经、同名经、表里经、相生相克经、奇经八脉
rows.en: Match symptom structure to abnormal channels; choose by own channel, same-name, exterior-interior, generating/controlling, or extraordinary vessels

rows.zh: 选穴应用
rows.en: Point application

rows.zh: “少而精”，以特定穴为主；循摸准确才进针；每针要有感传
rows.en: "Few and refined", mainly specific points; needle only after exact palpation; every needle should carry a propagated sensation

rows.zh: 手法探源
rows.en: Source of technique

rows.zh: 从俞跗“割皮解肌，决脉结筋”整理出割皮、操、结筋、解肌、决脉；另有搓针、放血、灸等
rows.en: Skin-cutting, cao, sinew-binding, muscle-loosening and vessel-opening drawn from Yu Fu; plus rubbing-needle, bleeding and moxa

title.zh: 他批评的做法与他的替代
title.en: What he criticises and what he puts in its place

rows.zh: 只记部位、主治、操作，或求“秘传”“特效”
rows.en: Learning only point site, indication, technique, or seeking "secret" or "special-effect" points

rows.zh: 自序：理论缺失使针灸学术发展受影响
rows.en: Preface: the long absence of theory has held acupuncture back

rows.zh: 学经络医学，用经典经络理论指导临床
rows.en: Learn channel medicine and let classical channel theory guide practice

rows.zh: 移植现代医学/科学理论解释针灸机理
rows.en: Transplanting modern medical or scientific theory to explain acupuncture

rows.zh: 自序：找到些“干爹干妈”，终因缺少血缘而分手
rows.en: Preface: found "adoptive parents" but, lacking blood ties, parted

rows.zh: “认祖归宗”，从经典解读经络本质
rows.en: "Return to ancestry": read the nature of channels from the classics

rows.zh: 医案只记什么症用什么穴，不讲症候结构与选穴依据
rows.en: Case records that give only symptom-and-points, without structure or rationale

rows.zh: 自序：后人难以掌握，只留下“经验穴”
rows.en: Preface: later physicians cannot use them; only "experience points" remain

rows.zh: 每案写出察经、辨经、选经、选穴和解读
rows.en: Every case here gives examination, differentiation, channel choice, points and commentary

rows.zh: 单一方药/穴组“全包”某病
rows.en: One formula or point group "covering" a disease

rows.zh: 头痛按语：违反中医理论
rows.en: Headache commentary: contrary to TCM theory

rows.zh: 同病异治：随察经与症候结构定选经选穴
rows.en: Same disease, different treatments, set by examination and symptom structure

how_to_use.zh: 读王居易的任何一案，先按这条链检查它有没有：主症→症候结构→察经→辨经→选经→选穴→刺灸法→疗效。他的“为什么取这个穴”几乎总是从察经与症候结构而不是从穴的主治里来。具体各环节见 wjy-02（流程）、wjy-03（察经）、wjy-04（选经）、wjy-05（选穴）、wjy-06（手法）。
how_to_use.en: Read any Wang Juyi case against this chain: chief complaint → symptom-complex structure → examination → differentiation → channel choice → points → technique → outcome. His "why this point" almost always comes from examination and symptom structure rather than from the point's listed indications. Details: wjy-02 (pathway), wjy-03 (examination), wjy-04 (channel choice), wjy-05 (points), wjy-06 (technique).

caveats.zh: 本库只依据《王居易针灸医案讲习录》(2014)：案例为其2006–2013年的临床病例。经络气化、症候结构等理论在书中只作引用式说明，详细论述留待其另一部专著，这里不补写。
caveats.en: Sources are limited to the 2014 case-book, whose cases are his own from 2006–2013. Qi-transformation and symptom-complex structure appear there only in brief, with the full treatment deferred to another planned monograph; nothing has been added from elsewhere.
